name: I Am Gorilla
summary:
Welcome to I Am Gorilla — the next big Gorilla Tag-inspired fan game!

Join a thriving community of players in an ever-evolving world where updates drop weekly — sometimes even daily! Whether you're here to tag, explore, or create, I Am Gorilla has something for everyone.

🎭 Customize Your Gorilla
Choose from 80+ unique cosmetics (and growing!) — from seasonal styles to wild, creative fits. Express yourself your way!
